FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 364
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Rodger M. Smitherman
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/16/2026
Senate Bill 364 as introduced would, beginning with the 2027-2028 school year, require
students in grades sixth through 12th, to complete a course in violence prevention, conflict
resolution, and mediation before graduation from high school. This would increase the
obligations of the State Department of Education by an undetermined amount dependent on the
cost to: (1) prepare and make available to local boards of education instructional materials,
models, and curricula as guidelines for the development of a violence prevention conflict
resolution and meditation course or program; and (2) assist in training teachers, to provide
effective instruction in violence prevention, conflict resolution and meditation.
Additionally, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of: (1) the local boards of
education to determine the appropriate curriculum to satisfy the requirements of this bill; and (2)
the State Board of Education to adopt rules to implement the provisions of this bill.
